Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

ggPSE 0.3.0

  • New symbol_position argument in ggPSE() and ggPSE_interactive() to draw the element symbol at the "center" (default), "top", "bottom", "left" or "right" of each tile.
  • New number_position argument to place the atomic number at any of the eight border positions of the tile (default "top-left").
  • New symbol_size argument to set the symbol size independently of base_size.
  • New ggPSE_text() adds a line of text per tile from a data column (positions "top", "center", "bottom", plus a fine-tuning position_nudge). Call it after ggPSE_donut(), which removes all text layers.
  • New symbol_nudge and number_nudge arguments shift the symbol / atomic number vertically from their *_position.
  • New label_na argument (hide symbols on tiles without data) and text_color (one fixed text colour instead of the automatic contrast colour) in ggPSE() and ggPSE_interactive().
  • highlight now also accepts a named list of symbol vectors, e.g. highlight = split(df$symbol, df$category), with the new highlight_colors argument (named or by position). legend_title now labels the highlight legend.
  • ggPSE_theme() no longer removes your colour scales ("minimal", "publication" and "dark" used to replace gradients and highlight colours by ggplot2’s defaults and turn the symbols salmon). Only "crazy" replaces the fills. The plot you pass in is no longer modified, and the docs examples now use ggPSE(...) |> ggPSE_theme("publication").
  • Redesigned "publication" theme for print: white background, thin dark-grey tile borders, white tiles for elements without data, compact legend that fits, and plain title, subtitle and caption styles.
  • Data given to ggPSE(), ggPSE_interactive(), ggPSE_bubble(), ggPSE_bar() and ggPSE_profile() is checked: symbols that are not element symbols (typos, lower case, stray spaces, element names, NA) are now an error that names them instead of leaving the tile silently blank, and so are non-numeric or all-NA value columns. Repeated rows for an element are allowed if they agree (e.g. one row per country), different values for the same element are an error. ggPSE_badge(), ggPSE_donut() and ggPSE_text() check the symbols too. Unknown symbols in highlight are an error.
  • A value column named atomic_number, col or row no longer clashes with the internal tile table (it used to give a blank plot or an error; ggPSE_interactive() silently used the tile positions instead of your values).
  • ggPSE_bubble() without size_col draws a blank table instead of failing.
  • README: fixed typos gPSE_donut and ggpse_elemts.
  • ggPSE_bar(): bars now start at zero by default, so their length is proportional to the value; before, the smallest value got no bar and constant values gave NaN. New limits argument; limits = range(x) gives the previous scaling. legend_title was never used (bars have no legend) and now warns when set. This changes the look of existing bar plots.
  • The element tables are lazy-loaded (LazyData: true): ggpse_elements and ggpse_grid are available after library(ggPSE) without data(), and the hard-coded copy of the tile table inside the package is gone.
  • ggPSE_badge(): badge_size was multiplied by 0.22 when ggflags is not installed; an unknown country code is shown as given instead of NA in the legend; elements with more than 3 countries and rows without a country code (e.g. Namibia’s "NA" read by read.csv()) now give a warning.
  • ggPSE_profile() gives a clear error if period or group is not a single number.
  • Documentation: tile_border no longer claims to detect the background.
  • Colours: ggPSE() and ggPSE_interactive() have new arguments colors (two or more colours), midpoint (diverging scales), limits (a fixed colour range, e.g. for the frames of an animation), breaks and labels, so the fill scale no longer has to be replaced afterwards. The text colour of each tile is now chosen against the colour the tile really gets (it was estimated from color_low/color_high on the range of each call, which changed it from frame to frame, used the wrong colour space and gave tiles without data the mid-gradient colour). Fills are unchanged; in the default gradient the symbol colour changes on a few tiles where it was wrong (4 of 87 in the electronegativity example).
  • text_color can now name a column in data with one colour per element.
  • Text layout is now defined in one internal helper shared by ggPSE() and ggPSE_interactive().
  • Documentation fix: base_size default is 10, not 8.

ggPSE 0.2.0

  • Added selection parameters for ggPSE()
  • New ggPSE_profile() to plot alongside groups or periods identifying trends.
  • Added interactivity using ggiraph
  • Updated the license to MIT.
  • Added a possible hierarchy for ggPSE_badge() and optional legend
  • Added ggPSE_theme wrapper for ease of publishing
  • ggPSE_save() for ease of use

ggPSE 0.1.0

  • Initial release
